data.name: Irfaanaht
data.gender_notes: Irfaanaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Irfaanaht is a Quranic name derived from the Arabic root 'r-f-n', which means 'to serve'. This name signifies the servant of God or one who is pure and devout. The name is mentioned in the Holy Quran in Surah Al-Qasas (28:68) as a title for Prophet Yusuf (Joseph). The name Irfaanaht carries the meaning “God's servant, or pure one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Irfaanaht usually hope their child will grow to embody god's servant, or pure one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of one's devotion and servitude to God Almighty.
data.etymology: Irfaanaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's servant, or pure one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irfaanaht total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
